text:
noelle: Quick thread to record choices for the micro-terminology sweep. Goal: reduce user confusion in examples and migration guides. Found inconsistent uses of 'variant', 'replica', 'model_id', and several casing mismatches.

gabi: Prefer: public-facing docs -> 'model variant' (two words) and use snake_case for config samples (model_variant_id). In code examples follow language idioms.

chetan: Agreed. Also recommend we treat 'replica' as an internal infra term only. Add a one-line glossary note and search-replace public pages.

doc-bot: lint: found 6 examples with model= in curl snippets; flagging for update to model_id JSON body.

noelle: I'll file small PRs: #501 replace curl bodies, #502 update examples casing, #503 glossary note. If you take one, reply here.

gabi: Taking #502. I'll grep for camelCase in JS examples and convert to idiomatic names while keeping a comment about mapping to config field names.

chetan: Taking #501. I'll update curl snippets to JSON with Content-Type and show alias mapping example.

noelle: For the glossary text let's use: "model variant — a user-selected model configuration/checkpoint. replica — a runtime copy used for scaling (internal)." Keep it short.

doc-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood/branches/501 (checks passed)

gabi: Noted one more place: quickstart uses 'route' ambiguously; will add clarification: 'API endpoint' for HTTP, 'console route' for UI.

noelle: Nice catch. Add that to #503. After merges we'll do a single canary deploy. Thanks all — short, focused changes so reviews stay fast.
